name: OpusClip
description: OpusClip turns long videos into ready-to-post short clips, right inside Claude. Submit a video file or YouTube URL for AI clipping, then read the resulting clips and transcripts, refine edits (reframe, auto-captions, censor sensitive moments), and organize clips into collections. Generate platform-ready social copy and schedule or publish clips to your connected social accounts - all from chat. It works on the footage you provide and supports complete workflows, from raw upload to a published short.

_published_faq.name: How do I add OpusClip to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OpusClip to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.opus.pro/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the OpusClip MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: OpusClip lists 28 MCP tools, including opusclip_whoami, opusclip_get_usage, opusclip_list_brand_templates, opusclip_list_projects, opusclip_list_clips, opusclip_describe_clip, opusclip_list_collections, opusclip_list_clips_in_collection, opusclip_get_transcript, opusclip_submit_project, opusclip_share_project, and opusclip_create_collection.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OpusClip?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to OpusClip in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
OpusClip requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
OpusClip is developed by Opusclip Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
